title: Completeness for arbitrary properties
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $P$ be a property of Boolean strings of length $n$, and let $w$ be such a string with $P(w)$. The PCPP system for $P$, on input $w$ and the proof encoding the dictator function that evaluates each sign vector at the coordinate indexed by $w$, accepts with probability $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A property $P$ of Boolean strings of length $n$
